crossRefs.note: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will…
All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and…
You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all…

translations.web: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
translations.bsb: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
translations.kjv: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
translations.asv: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.
